{{Dynamic a-list}}
[[North Korea]] ranks as the third least democratic country in the world in the [[Economist Intelligence Unit]]'s [[The Economist Democracy Index|Democracy Index]], while [[The Heritage Foundation]] and ''[[The Wall Street Journal]]''{{'}}s [[Index of Economic Freedom]] places the country as the one with least economic freedom. According to the [[Press Freedom Index]], North Korea has the second least free press in the world.

According to the [[Walk Free Foundation]]'s [[Global Slavery Index]], North Korea has the highest proportion of people in [[modern slavery]]. The [[Open Doors]] foundation's [[World Watch List]] lists the country as the worst persecutor of Christians in the world.<ref name=worldwatchlist2025/>
